You see a gold token.
It weighs 0.01 oz.

    Notes

    It can be exchanged with Yana for various weapons and for Creature Products that can be used to imbue them.

    25000 are needed for the Royal Costume Outfits Quest. You have a chance of finding one when opening a Surprise Jar.

    History

    This item was implemented in the Winter Update 2015, but only gained a use with the Summer Update 2016.
    Its weight was changed from 0.20 to 0.01 oz with the Winter Update 2021.
